primitives.subtask: Submit the university contact request about running out of storage

steps.action: Type “Running out of storage” in the “Subject” field

Type “My account has almost reached its storage limit. As a temporary measure, I have gone ahead and deleted older sent emails to free up some space, but this will only sustain me for a short period.
Could you please arrange to increase the storage quota for my account so I can continue receiving and managing emails without interruption?
Thank you,” in the “Message” field
